governance.note: Every entry is a planning record only. This registry grants no install/download/clone/pilot permission. A pilot requires an individually authorized task card in taskpacks/current plus user authorization for each external side effect. Licenses marked NOT_VERIFIED must be verified during DISCOVER/CLASSIFY before any pilot.
